up: Return the first 1000 activity rows where the assay targets the human single-protein protein CHEMBL1628465 (Transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily V member 6) and the activity is measured as an IC50 with pChEMBL values. For each activity, provide: assay.chembl_id (as assay_chembl_id), target_dictionary.target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id (as molecule_chembl_id), activities.standard_type, and activities.pchembl_value. Filter to exact activity records where activities.standard_relation = '=' and activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL, and limit to the human target with tid = 1628465. Order the final result set by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. Do not apply any additional filters for assay organims, confidence scores, or document types.
sql:
WITH target_activities AS (
  SELECT
    a.assay_id,
    a.molecule_chembl_id,
    a.standard_type,
    a.pchembl_value,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.type AS activity_type,
    a.relation AS activity_relation,
    a.value AS activity_value,
    a.units AS activity_units,
    a.text_value AS activity_text_value,
    a.standard_text_value AS standard_text_value,
    a.data_validity_comment,
    a.potential_duplicate,
    a.bao_endpoint,
    a.uo_units,
    a.qudt_units,
    a.toid,
    a.upper_value,
    a.standard_upper_value,
    a.src_id,
    a.doc_id,
    a.record_id,
    a.activity_comment
  FROM activities a
  WHERE
    a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.tid = 1628465
)
SELECT
  ds.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  ta.standard_type,
  ta.pchembl_value
FROM target_activities ta
JOIN assays ds ON ta.assay_id = ds.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ds.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON ta.molecule_chembl_id = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON ta.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molregno
WHERE
  ta.standard_relation = '='
  AND ta.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  md.chembl_id,
  ds.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000
